title: Assess exact action authority without redundant confirmation
statement: The MOD-006 responsibility shall assess exact action authority without redundant confirmation within the selected project and Change scope.

what.problem: Resumption can otherwise invent missing context or authority and lose obligations still relied upon.
what.desired_outcome: Assess exact action authority without redundant confirmation.

why.rationale: SR-007 requires a complete accountable contribution beyond general workflow progression or adoption.

conditions: A participant resumes or progresses governed work and prepares its next handoff.

contexts: The selected project, Change, adopted contract and exact action context.

how.approach: Apply the MOD-006 README.md handoff and authority collaboration through IF-011/009 with explicit participant-mediated IF-004 recording.

how_much.scope: Semantic resumption or authority interpretation. Operational maintenance execution, runtime adoption and overall IR-003 satisfaction remain separate.

acceptance_criteria: Assess an identified action, subject/state, participant, scope and conditions through IF-009 against attributable applicable policy, decision owner and grant or mandate; expose the exact unmet reserved boundary.
Recognize valid existing grants and bounded standing delegation across covered steps and resumed sessions without requesting confirmation solely because the session changed.

Identify the governing human boundaries for scope expansion, policy changes, reserved project tradeoffs and release decisions; require explicit applicable authorization for external mutation and destruction.

Withhold actions affected by revocation, supersession, completion, exceeded scope or failed conditions while retaining separately covered scope; higher authority and nondelegable decisions cannot be bypassed.
Keep favorable reviews, successful checks, routing suggestions and grants for other subjects separate from permission; authorization does not waive required independent assessment.

Require consumer rechecking of material authority conditions before a governed effect and reconciliation of uncertain prior effects before retry, preserving action-specific safeguards without treating an assessment as a reservation or new grant.
constraints: Proposed Design; no implementation, executed criterion verification or satisfaction claim.

sources.basis: Derive current handoff interpretation and action-bound authority through existing IF-011/009, with explicit participant recording, selective retention and one MOD-006 owner. Proposed Design only; no runtime adoption, execution or satisfaction claim.
